rawTitle.zh: 第 4 章 低维数据可视化

subtitle.zh: 你的 Crime 数据是宽格式，可视化常需要长格式。转换函数一行解决。
subtitle.en: Your Crime data is in wide format, but visualization often needs long format. A one-liner conversion function handles it.

explain.zh: 原 5.1 节用了 1985 美国 50 州犯罪数据（CSV），含 8 个犯罪指标列。
explain.en: Section 5.1 used 1985 U.S. crime data (CSV) for the 50 states, with 8 crime-indicator columns.

zh: 长格式（long）：每行一个观测，列 = 字段（如 {state, metric, value}）。优点：方便过滤、分组、绑定到 d3 join。
宽格式（wide）：每行一个实体，列 = 指标（如 {state, murder, robbery, ...}）。优点：人眼读得懂、直观。
转换：flatMap + 循环键名 = 几行代码搞定。
d3.autoType：自动推断列类型（数字、日期、布尔），省得手动 +d.field。
en: Long format (long): one observation per row, columns = fields (e.g., {state, metric, value}). Pros: easy to filter, group, and bind to a d3 join.
Wide format (wide): one entity per row, columns = metrics (e.g., {state, murder, robbery, ...}). Pros: human-readable and intuitive.
Conversion: flatMap + iterating over key names = a few lines of code.
d3.autoType: auto-infers column types (number, date, boolean), saving you from manual +d.field.

code.zh: ⭐ 关键代码
code.en: ★ Key Code

code.zh: ⭐ 关键点 1：d3.csv 第二参 = 类型转换回调
code.en: ★ Key Point 1: the second argument of d3.csv = the type-conversion callback

code.text: // ⭐ 自动类型推断（数字/日期/布尔） const raw = await d3.csv('./data/crime.csv', d3.autoType); console.log(raw[0]); // {state: 'Alabama', population: 3979000, murder: 350, ...}

code.zh: ⭐ d3.autoType 内部就是遍历每列、用 Number() / Date() / 字符串检测。能识别的就转、识别不了保持字符串。
code.en: ★ d3.autoType internally walks each column using Number() / Date() / string detection. Recognized types are converted; unrecognized values stay as strings.

code.zh: ⭐ 关键点 2：宽 → 长（flatMap 模式）
code.en: ★ Key Point 2: wide → long (the flatMap pattern)

code.text: // ⭐ flatMap：每行展开成多个观测 const long = raw.flatMap(d => ['murder', 'robbery', 'burglary'].map(key => ({ state: d.state, metric: key, value: d[key] })) ); // 现在可以做：d3.group(long, d => d.metric)

code.zh: ⭐ flatMap 是 ES2019，是 "map + 一维 flatten" 的简写。比 map().flat() 链式更直观。
code.en: ★ flatMap is ES2019, shorthand for “map + one-level flatten”. More intuitive than the map().flat() chain.

subtitle.zh: 数据空间 → 坐标系空间 → 屏幕空间。三层职责分明，错了就乱套。
subtitle.en: Data space → coordinate system space → screen space. Three layers with clearly separated responsibilities; mix them up and everything falls apart.

explain.zh: 原 5.1.2 节用散点展示 Crime 数据（murder vs robbery），坐标轴是 1985 数据。
explain.en: Section 5.1.2 used a scatter plot to display Crime data (murder vs. robbery), with the 1985 data on the coordinate axes.

zh:
三层空间：
  1. 数据空间：原始数值（如人口 27058000、谋杀率 8）
  2. 坐标系空间：归一化到 0..innerWidth（标准化坐标）
  3. 屏幕空间：加上 margin 偏移（最终像素位置）
为什么分层：坐标系空间内的元素（线、点）可以共享，切换屏幕尺寸时无需重算。d3.axisBottom 自动帮你做坐标系→屏幕。

scale 选型：
  • scaleLinear：均匀分布，最常用
  • scaleLog：跨数量级（人口从 53 万到 2700 万）
  • scaleSqrt：面积感知（圆面积映射到值）
  • scaleBand：类别轴（柱状图）
en:
Three-layer space:
  1. Data Space: raw values (e.g., population 27058000, murder rate 8)
  2. Coordinate Space: normalized to 0..innerWidth (standardized coordinates)
  3. Screen Space: add the margin offset (final pixel positions)

Why layer them: elements inside the coordinate system space (lines, points) can be shared — no recalculation when the screen size changes. d3.axisBottom handles the coordinate-system → screen step automatically.

Scale selection:
  • scaleLinear: uniform distribution, most common
  • scaleLog: spans orders of magnitude (population from 530k to 27M)
  • scaleSqrt: area-aware (maps circle area to value)
  • scaleBand: categorical axis (bar charts)

code.zh: ⭐ 关键代码
code.en: ★ Key Code

code.zh: ⭐ 关键点 1：数据空间 vs 屏幕空间，两层 scale
code.en: ★ Key Point 1: data space vs. screen space — two layers of scales

code.text: // 数据空间：值 → 坐标系 const xData = d3.scaleLinear() .domain([0, d3.max(data, d => d.x)]) .range([0, innerW]); // 屏幕空间：坐标系 → 屏幕（加 margin） const xScreen = d3.scaleLinear() .domain([0, innerW]) .range([M.l, M.l + innerW]); // 渲染：数据 → 坐标系 → 屏幕 .attr('cx', d => xScreen(xData(d.x)))

code.zh: ⭐ 错位示范：直接把 domain/max 和 range/[M.l, M.l+innerW] 写在一个 scale 里 → 改 margin 要改两处。三层分立就清爽。
code.en: ★ Misalignment example: writing domain=max and range=[M.l, M.l+innerW] in one scale → changing the margin means editing two places. The three-layer separation keeps things clean.

code.zh: ⭐ 关键点 2：log scale 跨数量级
code.en: ★ Key Point 2: log scale spans orders of magnitude

code.text: // 50 州人口从 53 万到 2700 万（差 50 倍） // linear 缩放下，小州挤成一团，CA/NY/TX 占满屏幕 const xLog = d3.scaleLog() .domain([1, d3.max(data, d => d.x)]) .range([0, innerW]);

code.zh: ⭐ log 轴对"指数增长"数据特别合适。人的视觉是"乘法"而不是"加法"，所以 log 让"等比数列"在屏幕上"等距"。
code.en: ★ A log axis is especially well-suited for “exponential growth” data. Human vision is “multiplicative” rather than “additive”, so log turns a “geometric sequence” into “equally-spaced” points on screen.

subtitle.zh: 同 50 个点，用 10 种 line.curve 画风各异。什么时候用哪种？
subtitle.en: Same 50 points, 10 different line.curve styles. Which to use when?

explain.zh: 原 5.1.3 节用折线 + 散点展示趋势。原始代码用了 curveCatmullRom，没讲为什么。
explain.en: Section 5.1.3 used a line + scatter plot to show trends. The original code used curveCatmullRom without explaining why.

zh:
插值 vs 拟合：
  • 插值（interpolation）：曲线经过所有数据点（如 Catmull-Rom、Natural）
  • 拟合（fitting）：曲线不经过数据点，只反映趋势（如线性回归 LOESS）
d3.line().curve() 提供 10+ 种 curve，最常用：
step 系：用于离散阶跃（数字信号、状态切换）
catmullRom / natural：过所有点的张力样条，"看起来平滑"
monotoneX：保持原数据序列单调（不会出现伪震荡）
选择原则：数据有顺序性 → monotoneX / linear；数据本身抖动大 → catmullRom / basis 平滑；离散状态 → step
en:
Interpolation vs. Fitting:
  • Interpolation: the curve passes through every data point (e.g., Catmull-Rom, Natural)
  • Fitting: the curve does not necessarily pass through data points, only reflects the trend (e.g., linear regression, LOESS)
d3.line().curve() offers 10+ curves; the most commonly used are:
step family: for discrete steps (digital signals, state transitions)
catmullRom / natural: tension splines that pass through all points — “looks smooth”
monotoneX: preserves the monotonicity of the original data sequence (no spurious oscillations)
Selection principles: ordered data → monotoneX / linear; jittery data → catmullRom / basis to smooth; discrete states → step

code.zh: ⭐ 关键代码
code.en: ★ Key Code

code.zh: ⭐ 关键点 1：d3.line + curve 一行切换
code.en: ★ Key Point 1: switch curves with d3.line + curve in one line

code.text: const line = d3.line() .x(d => xScale(d.x)) .y(d => yScale(d.y)) .curve(d3.curveCatmullRom); // <- 这一行换 curve 类型 svg.append('path').datum(data).attr('d', line);

code.zh: ⭐ datum(data) 把数组当整体传给 path（不是每个元素绑一个）。d3.line 内部循环生成 M/L/C 命令。
code.en: ★ datum(data) passes the array as a whole to the path (not one element at a time). Inside, d3.line loops to generate M/L/C commands.

code.zh: ⭐ 关键点 2：拟合 vs 插值的取舍
code.en: ★ Key Point 2: the trade-off between fitting and interpolation

code.text: // 拟合：d3.regressionLinear / d3.regressionLoess import { regressionLinear } from 'd3-regression'; const lin = regressionLinear() .x(d => d.population) .y(d => d.murder) .domain([0, d3.max(data, d => d.population)]); const points = lin(data); // 起点-终点 svg.append('path').attr('d', d3.line()(points));

code.zh: ⭐ 经验法则：散点超过 30 个 → 用拟合；散点 < 10 个 → 用插值（保持信息完整）。Crime 数据 50 个州 → 拟合更稳。
code.en: ★ Rule of thumb: more than 30 points → use fitting; fewer than 10 points → use interpolation (preserve full information). Crime data has 50 states → fitting is more robust.

subtitle.zh: 人眼对斜率的估计 不是 线性的。45° 是视觉"中点"。
subtitle.en: Human perception of slope is not linear. 45° is the visual “midpoint”.

explain.zh: 原 5.1.4 节提到"平均倾斜度最优为 45°"，但没解释原因。
explain.en: Section 5.1.4 mentions that “the optimal average slope is 45°” without explaining why.

zh:
Cleveland 1984 实验：让被试估计直线的斜率，发现：
  • 斜率 = 0° 或 90° 时，估计误差最大
  • 斜率 = 45° 时，估计最准
  • 呈 U 型曲线
Stevens 幂律：感知斜率 ≈ (真实斜率)^1.0 ~ 1.3。即人眼把"陡度"夸张了 30%。

设计原则：
  • 关键数据斜率落在 30°~60° 区间最稳
  • 对比增长曲线时，用 log 轴让陡度落在 45° 左右
  • 避免在 5° 以下或 85° 以上做趋势对比（误差太大）
en:
Cleveland 1984 experiment: subjects were asked to estimate line slopes:
  • Slope = 0° or 90°: estimation error is largest
  • Slope = 45°: estimation is most accurate
  • The error curve is U-shaped
Stevens’ power law: perceived slope ≈ (actual slope)1.0–1.3. In other words, the eye exaggerates “steepness” by about 30%.

Design principles:
  • Key data slopes are most stable in the 30°–60° range
  • When comparing growth curves, use a log axis so steepness lands near 45°
  • Avoid trend comparisons below 5° or above 85° (errors grow too large)

code.zh: ⭐ 关键代码
code.en: ★ Key Code

code.zh: ⭐ 关键点 1：极坐标转笛卡尔坐标
code.en: ★ Key Point 1: convert polar to Cartesian coordinates

code.text: // 角度 → 屏幕坐标 function lineAtAngle(angleDeg, length = 240, origin = {x: 100, y: 240}) { const r = (angleDeg * Math.PI) / 180; return { x1: origin.x, y1: origin.y, x2: origin.x + length * Math.cos(r), y2: origin.y - length * Math.sin(r) // SVG y 向下为正，所以取负 }; }

code.zh: ⭐ SVG 的 y 轴向下（与数学相反），所以 sin 角度项要取负。这是初学者最常踩的坑。
code.en: ★ SVG’s y axis points downward (opposite to math convention), so the sine term must be negated. This is the most common pitfall for beginners.

code.zh: ⭐ 关键点 2：把抽象理论变成可调参数
code.en: ★ Key Point 2: turn abstract theory into tunable parameters

code.text: // 让用户拖滑块改角度，立刻看到"哪段斜率最稳" const slider = document.getElementById('angle'); slider.addEventListener('input', e => { const angle = +e.target.value; renderLine(angle); // 30°~60° 误差小，0°/90° 误差大 });

subtitle.zh: 给定标量场 + 阈值，追踪 值 = 阈值 的曲线。
subtitle.en: Given a scalar field + threshold, trace the curve where value = threshold .

explain.zh: 原 5.2.2 节用 Marching Squares 提取 Crime 数据的等值线。原始代码是截图占位。
explain.en: Section 5.2.2 used Marching Squares to extract isocontours from Crime data. The original code was a screenshot placeholder.

zh: Marching Squares 原理：把标量场离散化为网格，每个 cell 4 个角的"是否大于阈值"决定 case 编号 0~15（2⁴=16 种）。每种 case 对应 0/1/2 条线段，把"超过阈值"和"未超过阈值"的两片区域分开。
16 种 case：编码 bit0=BL、bit1=BR、bit2=TR、bit3=TL。
扩展到 3D：Marching Cubes（Lorensen & Cline 1987），2⁸=256 种 case，常用于医学 MRI / CT 等值面提取。

应用场景：
  • 地形等高线（地图）
  • 医学影像（MRI/CT 等值面）
  • 密度等高图（核密度估计）
  • 天气预报（等温线、等压线）
en: How Marching Squares works: discretize the scalar field into a grid. For each cell, the “above threshold / not” state of its 4 corners yields a case index from 0 to 15 (24 = 16 cases). Each case corresponds to 0, 1, or 2 line segments that separate the “above-threshold” region from the “not” region.
16 cases: encoded as bit0=BL, bit1=BR, bit2=TR, bit3=TL.
Extension to 3D: Marching Cubes (Lorensen & Cline, 1987), with 28 = 256 cases, widely used for extracting isosurfaces from medical MRI / CT scans.

Application scenarios:
  • Terrain contour lines (maps)
  • Medical imaging (MRI / CT isosurfaces)
  • Density contours (kernel density estimation)
  • Weather forecasting (isotherms, isobars)

code.zh: ⭐ 关键代码
code.en: ★ Key Code

code.zh: ⭐ 关键点 1：16 case lookup table（核心数据结构）
code.en: ★ Key Point 1: the 16-case lookup table (core data structure)

code.zh: ⭐ saddle case（5 和 10）是 Marching Squares 唯一需要"判断中心值"的歧义情况——其它 14 种 case 一查表就出。Saddle 用 cell 中心点对比阈值决定连线方向。
code.en: ★ The saddle case (5 and 10) is the only ambiguous situation in Marching Squares that requires “checking the center value” — the other 14 cases are resolved with a simple lookup. For saddle cases, compare the cell center to the threshold to decide how to connect the line segments.

code.zh: ⭐ 关键点 2：位运算拼 case 编号
code.en: ★ Key Point 2: assemble the case index with bitwise operations

code.html:
// 4 个角是否 > 阈值 → 4 位二进制 → case 编号
let code = 0;
if (bl > threshold) code |= 1;   // bit 0
if (br > threshold) code |= 2;   // bit 1
if (tr > threshold) code |= 4;   // bit 2
if (tl > threshold) code |= 8;   // bit 3

const lines = EDGE_TABLE[code];   // 查表
code.text: // 4 个角是否 > 阈值 → 4 位二进制 → case 编号 let code = 0; if (bl > threshold) code |= 1; // bit 0 if (br > threshold) code |= 2; // bit 1 if (tr > threshold) code |= 4; // bit 2 if (tl > threshold) code |= 8; // bit 3 const lines = EDGE_TABLE[code]; // 查表
